headline: Japan Petroleum Exploration to Acquire Stake in Norway's Goliat Oil Field
summary: Japan Petroleum Exploration (JAPEX) has agreed to acquire an 8% stake in Norway's Goliat oil field from Equinor for $65 million. The deal also involves JAPEX transferring its 3.5% interest in the Verdande field to Equinor.
why: JAPEX is expanding its upstream energy portfolio in Norway to reach production targets exceeding 10,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day by the 2030s.

impacts.name: Japan Petroleum Exploration
impacts.why: The acquisition represents a strategic expansion of the company's asset base.
